message:
As I was rummaging through some old boxes the other day, I stumbled upon a stack of board games and forgotten puzzles that my grandkids used to enjoy. It reminded me how much fun we can have with simple activities, especially when we take a moment to unplug and connect as a family. 

In this digital age, it’s easy to forget the joy of learning basic safety skills together, and there’s a wonderful resource out there that encourages just that. Rediscovering low-tech fun can not only help us bond but also teach our little ones some valuable life skills. 

What’s a low-tech activity your family enjoys?
